title: Oozy French Cheese Gratin
description: A pungent and juicy French dish featuring caramelized cheese, perfect for a hangover cure. This kosher-friendly gratin is served in a lacquerware bowl.
instructions: Butter the inside of a lacquerware bowl.
In a large skillet, caramelize the onions over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
In a separate saucepan, combine the white wine and chicken broth.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until reduced by half.
In a large bowl, combine the Comte and Emmental cheese.
Add the cooked onion and garlic mixture to the cheese and stir to combine.
Pour the reduced wine and broth mixture over the cheese mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared lacquerware bowl and top with additional grated cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes or until golden and bubbly.
